title: DDxElement
description: An alternative, closely-related condition typically considered later in the differential diagnosis process along with the signs that are used to distinguish it.

type.title: Type

distinguishingSign.description: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.
